title: PrismarineJS Mineflayer
content_excerpt: Mineflayer is a powerful, stable, and high-level JavaScript API for creating Minecraft Java Edition bots. It provides entity knowledge and tracking, block knowledge, physics and movement, inventory management, crafting, digging, and building.
evidence_notes: Reference implementation for protocol-layer bot capabilities, tool behavior, inventory operations, pathfinding plugins, and common execution errors.
notes: Use repository docs, tests, examples, and issues as evidence. Do not treat every GitHub issue as authoritative without code or maintainer confirmation.
